notes: Added after most word-final consonants, probably a schwa: *manuk > *manukə > Teanu menuko, Lovono menuka, Tanema manuke; an exclusively shared innovation (p. 5).
'Occasional velarisation of *t to /k/ before a high back vowel /u/': *patu > *vaku > Teanu voko, Lovono and Tanema vaka (p. 6). Lackey & Boerger (2021: 384) reanalyse it as coda *t > k.

Lenis reflexes of *t: Teanu t, Lovono l, Tanema Ø in sit, three, sugarcane, soul and others (Table 3, after Tryon & Hackman 1983: 71). Gaimard's early 19th-century wordlists write these Tanema words with r, so Tanema had r two centuries ago (p. 9).
